workflows.purpose: Download caller-produced current and baseline artifacts under read-only authority, normalize bounded size evidence, and preserve deterministic advisory or blocking reports without executing consumer code.

failure_semantics.description: Invalid, missing, incomplete, or unsupported evidence and artifact transfer failures remain explicit; blocking mode preserves a completed report before failing the job, while advisory mode reports the same state without mutation.

inputs.description: Retention for the normalized machine-readable budget report.

outputs.name: report-artifact-name
outputs.description: Uploaded artifact containing the deterministic budget report.

outputs.name: report-sha256
outputs.description: SHA-256 of the exact deterministic JSON report.

outputs.name: status
outputs.description: Overall normalized budget state.

outputs.name: measurement-count
outputs.description: Number of normalized artifact measurements.

workflows.purpose: Evaluate inactivity and explicit exemptions under a conditional read-only permission boundary, then optionally apply the exact warning-first lifecycle plan; Issues authority exists only when issue processing is explicitly enabled.

failure_semantics.description: A non-default-branch apply, invalid bounds, missing labels, incomplete provider evidence, plan checksum drift, or moved live state fails before mutation. Provider failure during a multi-item apply may leave earlier writes visible. Fresh runs reconcile open-item warnings and resets; optional metadata that fails after a successful close needs maintainer review or reopen recovery. No item can close without its own prior trusted warning marker.

inputs.description: Permit warned items to become closure-eligible after the warning window.

inputs.name: warning-message

inputs.name: close-message
inputs.description: Optional closure text before Relay appends recovery guidance and its lifecycle marker.

inputs.name: artifact-retention-days
inputs.description: Retention for the checksum-bound advisory plan and apply evidence.
